response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but his career has moved almost entirely into web/TypeScript/Node.js and D-lang ecosystems, with only brief, dated C++ exposure (2014-2015 at National Instruments) and no evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, MQTT, industrial protocols, or message-broker/event-driven architecture at the scale described. The role requires deep, current C++/STL architecture work plus industrial cybersecurity expertise that this profile does not demonstrate.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many stacks
Demonstrated low-latency, async/multi-threaded systems work (DLang at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby)
Strong ownership, mentoring, and community/technical communication track record
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and over a decade old, not the primary or recent focus
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity standards experience
No mention of MQTT, REST-based IoT work, message brokers, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering, concurrency, and architecture skills
